name: ru.vhrgames.sdk
description: Mandatory VHR Games SDK for Unity 6 WebGL titles. Provides player profile + name resolution, friends, player stats/progression, achievements, game sessions, economy (game catalog items, inventory, purchases confirmed by the player in the VHR platform window; no in-game top-up, spend or grant), in-game ads (interstitial/rewarded via the VHR host page, Yandex Advertising Network), leaderboard, tournaments, lobby/matchmaking + relay multiplayer, server matchmaking (UDP, domain/uuid) and session services that talk to the VHR backend, plus a build marker handshake (vhr-sdk.json) that the backend validates on upload, and Unity Editor testing of every API against the real backend with a sandbox key (VHR menu: Editor testing and Game catalog windows). One-file installer (Installer~/VhrSdkInstaller.cs) and one-click updates (VHR menu: SDK update window, daily version check, WebGL build guard against SDK versions below the platform minimum). Builds without this SDK are rejected on confirm-upload.

samples.description: Minimal MonoBehaviour shop: init, balance, catalog items, purchase confirmed by the player, owned items and the top-up button.

_vhr_install_note: Unity ignores scopedRegistries in a package manifest: they must be in the PROJECT Packages/manifest.json. Easiest: drop Installer~/VhrSdkInstaller.cs (https://vhrgames.ru/downloads/VhrSdkInstaller.cs) into Assets/Editor - it adds both registries (OpenUPM: com.cysharp, jp.hadashikick; UnityNuGet: org.nuget) and the dependencies. Then R3 (com.cysharp.r3), its core DLLs (org.nuget.r3 + transitive org.nuget.*) and VContainer resolve automatically - no NuGetForUnity. See README.md > Installation.
